{{Top|leg}}
'''Collafa spice''' was a kind of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Master Chef]] [[Tavvar Va'ran]] of the [[Manarai]] restaurant on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] once introduced a small bit of collafa spice, among other ingredients, into the meal of [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Fendrilon Koozar]], which later caused Koozar to fall into a fit of hallucination, leading to his [[Death/Legends|death]].
